findings.title: Historical catalog mode never returns archived model versions
findings.evidence: _published_versions_stmt() applies `where(ModelloDocumentoVersione.stato == STATO_PUBBLICATO)` unconditionally, even when historical=True (only pubblicato_da/pubblicato_a filters are added). FR-006a MUST support a historical mode that "restituisce versioni archiviate", US1 Acceptance Scenario 4 and SC-007 require retrieving ARCHIVIATO versions via storico, and data-model.md State Rules state "Le versioni precedenti della stessa variante sono ARCHIVIATO e disponibili solo nello storico". The DB index uq_modello_versione_pubblicata_corrente forces a superseded version to ARCHIVIATO, after which it is invisible in every endpoint. Seed migrations 0004/0006 create only PUBBLICATO/BOZZA versions and no test exercises an archived version; contracts/geban-catalog-api.openapi.yaml ModelloCatalogo.stato enum is `[PUBBLICATO]` only, contradicting the spec.
findings.recommendation: In historical mode include ARCHIVIATO (and per data-model SOSPESO) versions instead of restricting to PUBBLICATO; seed at least one ARCHIVIATO demo version; widen the OpenAPI stato enum; add an integration test asserting storico returns a superseded ARCHIVIATO version while campi-richiesti/valida keep rejecting it (SC-007).

findings.title: Payload validation ignores declared field constraints (vincoli)
findings.evidence: validate_payload() only checks not-found, not-published, extra fields, required presence and JSON type via _matches_type(); it never reads ModelloCampoRichiesto.validazione. Seed migrations 0004/0006 populate real constraints ({"minLength": 1} on codice_bando/titolo_it/sede_prescelta_it/titolo_en, {"minimum": 1} on numero_posti) and catalog/service.py exposes them in the contract JSON schema, but the server accepts `numero_posti: 0` or `codice_bando: ""` with `{"valido": true, "errori": []}`. FR-011/FR-012 require validation of "vincoli dichiarati" and "coerenza con la versione modello pubblicata"; SC-003 depends on it. This defeats the stated purpose of US3 (blocking incoherent data before generation).
findings.recommendation: After the type check, validate each value against field.validazione (minLength/maxLength/minimum/maximum/pattern/enum) and/or the generated JSON schema, emitting TIPO_NON_VALIDO or a dedicated VINCOLO_NON_RISPETTATO code aligned with infra/openapi/errors.md; add tests for numero_posti=0 and empty required strings.

findings.title: All P1 payload-validation and catalog-service tests skipped in deterministic run
findings.evidence: regression_results show `test_validazione_payload_api.py sssssssss` (9/9 skipped) and `test_catalog_service_integration.py sssss` (5/5 skipped) — 14 skipped — because tests/support/postgres.py skips when Docker/Testcontainers is unavailable and DATABASE_URL is unset. The always-run catalog tests (test_catalogo_modelli_api.py, test_campi_richiesti_api.py, test_catalogo_tipologia_sol.py, etc.) all install a FakeCatalogService via dependency_overrides and never exercise real logic; test_catalogo_tipologia_sol.py asserts on a fake that unconditionally raises TIPOLOGIA_SOL_NON_VALIDA. No Docker-free test covers CatalogService/PayloadValidationService/repository, so FR-003/FR-004/FR-011..FR-015/FR-012a/FR-020/FR-021/FR-022 have zero deterministic coverage in the gate environment.
findings.recommendation: Add a portable fallback (SQLite engine or an in-memory fake repository) or direct unit tests for PayloadValidationService and CatalogService so the P1 requirements are verified without Docker; alternatively provision PostgreSQL in the quality-gate environment and treat skips of these modules as gate failures.

findings.title: Deterministic regression command exits non-zero (exit_code 1)
findings.evidence: regression_results: command `uv --directory backend run pytest -m "not e2e"` reports `116 passed, 14 skipped, 12 deselected` but exit_code is 1. pytest.ini sets `filterwarnings = error`; stderr shows an ExceptionGroup of PytestUnraisableExceptionWarning for `unclosed <socket.socket ... family=AF_UNIX>` raised in pytest_unconfigure/collect_unraisable — the Testcontainers/Docker fallback path in tests/support/postgres.py leaves sockets open when Docker is absent, and filterwarnings=error escalates them to a fatal error at teardown. The ADEV quality gate's PASS/FAIL depends on deterministic test results, so the regression command as configured fails in any Docker-less environment (CI, reviewer sandbox).
findings.recommendation: Close the leaked Docker/Testcontainers client sockets in tests/support/postgres.py teardown (or guard the import/instantiation), or narrow filterwarnings so third-party teardown ResourceWarnings are not escalated; ensure the gate treats a non-zero pytest exit as FAIL and re-run with the leak fixed.

findings.title: Empty value satisfies required-field check
findings.evidence: `value_present = field.codice in request.dati and request.dati[field.codice] is not None`. An empty string "" (or [] / {}) for a mandatory field is treated as present and passes _matches_type, so validate_payload returns valido=true. spec.md Edge Cases explicitly lists "Il payload contiene valori vuoti per campi obbligatori" as a case that must be handled; it currently is not.
findings.recommendation: Treat empty string / empty collection as absent for required fields (or reject explicitly with CAMPO_OBBLIGATORIO / CAMPO_INGLESE_MANCANTE) and add regression tests.

findings.title: Complex array/object fields are not structurally validated
findings.evidence: _matches_type() for `array` returns only isinstance(value, list) and for `object` only isinstance(value, dict). FR-008a requires a structured JSON sub-schema (sotto-campi, tipi, obbligatorieta', ordine, vincoli) and spec.md Edge Cases require rejecting array/object payloads with missing sub-fields, wrong sub-types or extra sub-fields. ModelloCampoRichiesto has no sub-field schema column and validate_payload performs no nested validation, so any dict/list passes regardless of internal shape.
findings.recommendation: Model a sub-schema for array/object fields (data-model + campo_modello column) and validate nested structure (sub-field presence, types, additionalProperties=false) during payload validation per FR-008a.

findings.title: tasks.md marks tasks complete for artifacts that do not exist
findings.evidence: T053/T054 are [x] but reference backend/tests/validation/test_validazione_bando_inglese.py, which is absent (the bando_inglese scenarios live in test_validazione_payload_api.py). T065 is [x] for backend/app/validation/errors.py and T066 for backend/app/catalog/errors.py, neither of which exists — the error codes were consolidated into backend/app/common/errors.py. Traceability between tasks.md and the repository is inaccurate.
findings.recommendation: Update tasks.md to point at the real files (test_validazione_payload_api.py, app/common/errors.py) or add the referenced modules, so completed-task claims match the tree.

findings.title: quickstart test evidence not reproducible in the gate
findings.evidence: The "Verifica Test" section records `126 passed, 12 deselected` for `uv run pytest -m "not e2e"` on 2026-07-31, but the deterministic re-run in regression_results yields `116 passed, 14 skipped, 12 deselected` and exit_code 1. The recorded evidence overstates portable coverage and hides that 14 P1 tests are environment-gated.
findings.recommendation: Record the command's exit status and skip count, note the Docker/PostgreSQL prerequisite, and update the figure after adding Docker-free coverage.

findings.title: Auth bypass toggle has no environment guard
findings.evidence: require_principal() returns mock_principal() whenever settings.gemodo_use_mock_principal is true, and mock_principal grants roles DOCUMENTI_VIEWER,DOCUMENTI_GENERATORE (settings.py default GEMODO_MOCK_ROLES) with client geban-backend. The flag defaults to False and quickstart documents it as local/test only, but a single env var (GEMODO_USE_MOCK_PRINCIPAL=true) disables all JWT signature/issuer/audience/role checks with no assertion that the runtime is non-production.
findings.recommendation: Gate the mock principal behind an explicit non-production environment check (e.g. refuse to start with mock enabled unless an APP_ENV=local/test is also set) and log a prominent warning when it is active.

findings.title: Feature 009 implemented but never passed the independent gate
findings.evidence: feature_inventory lists specs/002..009 as review_status PENDING / needs_review true. specs/009-fondamenta-mock-test-qualita is implemented (backend/app/quality/*, contract+integration tests passing in regression_results) yet has last_verdict null; specs/002-008 are spec-only with no backend implementation. Only 001 is READY.
findings.recommendation: Run the independent quality gate for 009 (its shipped code underpins 001's seed/tests) and keep 002-008 flagged as not-yet-implemented rather than merely unreviewed.

findings.title: tokensave index stale and served from main, not the review branch
findings.evidence: tokensave_status: "Index last synced 1d 1h ago" and "branch 'chore/adopt-adev-standard' is not tracked — serving from 'main'". tokensave/codegraph are optional (required:false) so non-blocking. The branch diff only touches .specify/, .adev/, AGENTS.md, .claude/, .codex/, .mcp.json, so backend code is identical to main and dependency-impact analysis is effectively unaffected, but graph queries do not reflect the exact branch state.
findings.recommendation: Note the limitation; if graph-assisted impact analysis is needed for this branch, run `tokensave branch add chore/adopt-adev-standard` / `tokensave sync` first (with user consent).
